name: ver02-c1-grapple-terminals
description: S6 checkpoint C1 / VER-02: terminal cleanup of the single-link native grapple owner (SummonGrabComponent with one held target; native UnitPartGrappleInitiator/UnitPartGrappleTarget, the hold buff with SummonHoldComponent, the grappled buff and the holder's UnitPartSummonGrappleLinks record). The product runs alone. Launch 1 loads the disposable fixture save and summons Expanded Summoning crocodiles through the product's own execution ability; each establishes a hold on a disposable target through the engine's RuleAttackWithWeapon for its bite. Real terminals follow: holder death, target death, a second terminal on an ended pair (the surviving holder's native expiry), a holding summon's native SummonedUnitBuff expiry, and the native Dismissal spell where it applies. An independent holding pair and an unrelated buff are the controls; direct release calls are a control only. Raw stored link records and live constraints are read separately before teardown. One pair is left holding, named, and saved. Launch 2, a fresh process, loads that save and checks the native load reset (ACTIVE_SUMMON_GRAPPLES_RESET_SAFELY_ON_RELOAD) at load and after native controller ticks.
